title: Instruction Workflow definition
description: Native instruction/workflow dialect, revision 1. See the normative workflow reference for scheduler, expression and runtime requirements.

act_for.description: the person this workflow's schedule, loop and once firings act for with nobody there (RFC 0044 M4): each firing approved by them on their own device (ciba), or with their grant and nobody asked (standing) — as their identity.delegation template allows. Only the operator's own configuration declares it; beside any other start, or a webhook wait, it is refused (act_for_trigger_not_allowed), and a device principal is refused as act_for_device_principal

principal.description: the typed principal, never a display string: an oidc subject (issuer, sub), or a pinned operator or x509 principal by its a2a.principals rule's id

scope.description: what max_runs counts: every run of this workflow (default), or every run about the same `key` — the difference between a queue and a per-entity lock

durable.description: false = runs are memory-only (no checkpoints, gone after a restart) — the fast path for recomputable work; absent = the store.durability.work default (durable)

key.description: the logical thing a run is ABOUT, rendered from the trigger payload (e.g. "{{payload.account_id}}"); required by concurrency.scope: key

priority.description: contention weight: `low` sheds one pressure level earlier and is scheduled last; a tiebreak under scarcity, not a reservation

reducer.description: how concurrent writes to this key combine; declaring it makes concurrency a policy rather than a race

schema.description: a JSON Schema every write to this key must satisfy

state.description: declared run variables — {key: {schema, reducer}}

tool.description: register this workflow as a first-class tool — a callable procedure with retry, breaker, idempotency and a human gate INSIDE one apparent call. Startup config only; tags are DERIVED from what the steps reach.

mode.description: sync parks the caller on the run and returns its output; async returns a handle

name.description: the tool name callers see; may not shadow an internal contract

unload.description: what happens to LIVE runs when this definition is retired (removed, replaced or deleted)

timeout.description: how long a drain may take

anyOf.description: a CEL guard: the step runs only when it is true
a decision guard (asked as the decide step `<id>.when`): the step runs only when the statement holds, surely; otherwise it is pruned

confidence.description: the least confidence the guard holds at; default roles.decide's

model.description: the model that decides; default roles.decide

noul.description: the statement the step runs on when it holds

state.description: what is decided about (a value or template); default: the outputs of depends_on by step id, or the inputs (a foreach/batch element in its body)
